scopes.description: Complete supplied R workflow: patent-data construction followed by the reported tables and analyses.

requirements.description: Raw PatEx application_data source required at Data/application_data.csv.zip; code reads application_number, patent_number, application_type, filing_date, and patent_issue_date.

routes.description: A public full-set 2017 PatEx release is listed, and USPTO documentation says previous releases included application_type. This is a historical compatibility candidate; the full required field set and date coverage for the selected release remain unconfirmed. CSV ZIP repackaging to the author path is ordinary preparation after acquisition.

requirements.description: Raw historical masterfile required at Data/historical_masterfile.zip; source reads patent, uspc, uspc_sub, prior_dt, pub_dt, disp_dt, and exp_dt.

routes.description: USPTO publishes a 2014 historical masterfile candidate; the source expects the named native fields and the period/coverage required by the full workflow has not been confirmed from the inspected documentation.

requirements.description: Raw continuity parent relationships required at Data/continuity_parents.csv.zip; code consumes parent_application_number, application_number, and continuation_type.

routes.description: The documented PatEx continuity_parents file contains the relationship identifiers and continuation_type; download/reformatting to the author path remains preparation.

requirements.description: Raw child continuity file required at Data/continuity_children.csv.zip. The source reads application_number (parent), child_application_number (child), and continuation_type, then normalizes those to internal parent_application_number/application_number names. It separately reads the child feed for PCT-child detection as well.

routes.description: The public PatEx continuity_children table remains a candidate, but the inspected 2019 documentation places continuation_type only in continuity_parents, while this source read requires it in the raw child feed. The construction code also reads both parent and child feeds for PCT-child detection. Existing evidence does not establish that reversing parent rows supplies the complete child-row, type, and PCT contract, so keep this route unverified.

requirements.description: Raw foreign-priority input required at Data/foreign_priority.csv.zip; source expects application_number, foreign_parent_date, and parent_country_code.

routes.description: The inspected PatEx documentation names the current field parent_country as a jurisdiction string, while the supplied source compares parent_country_code to US. Confirm exact values and a semantics-preserving US/non-US mapping before use.

requirements.description: Raw transactions input required at Data/transactions.csv.zip; source consumes application_number, event_code, and recorded_date for EPRQ/NPRQ.

routes.description: PatEx is a public product candidate and documents transaction fields; coverage of the EPRQ and NPRQ event codes in the selected release remains unconfirmed. Repackaging to the author CSV ZIP path is preparation after acquisition.

requirements.description: Raw all_inventors input required at Data/all_inventors.csv.zip; source consumes application_number, inventor_name_last, and inventor_rank.

routes.description: PatEx documents an all_inventors product, but the complete expected field and population/period compatibility for the selected release remains to be confirmed. CSV ZIP repackaging to the author path is ordinary preparation after acquisition.

The analysis script clears its workspace and loads Environments/AGPT - Environment.RData. The construction script produces the eight consumed objects Data, Data.firm, Data.agglomeration, Moves.all, Moves.to_control, Inventors, Combined, and Assignees; prepare that generated handoff after construction by serializing exactly this object set. This is export/handoff preparation, not an additional raw input or unknown scientific construction.

Approved static source coverage leaves create-data.R lines 242–243 unread and a targeted view also reported physical line 276 withheld as an absolute-path line. These bounded ranges do not establish an additional raw read, defect, or inactive branch; closure remains incomplete pending safe coverage.

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies the patent application period and reports the final firm-year analysis samples.
evidence.quote:
The sample begins with all successful patent applications filed with the USPTO between
       January 1, 2003, and December 31, 2006. We identify assignees, inventors, locations, and
       successful patent applications—including patent assignments, disclosure timing, and
       citations—using data from patentsview.org, the USPTO patent database, and Stoffman et
       al. (2022). We consider patents of domestic public and private firms, individuals, and
       nonprofits. We remove inventors living in Texas—whose judiciary decided Alcatel v.
       Brown and Brown’s appeal—from the analysis to avoid any potential endogeneity
       concerns.

       After merging all data, our final sample contains 8,877 observations for all firms in ISS
       Incentive Lab from 2006 to 2017. We perform one untabulated analysis using this “full
       sample” (see Table OA1 in the Online Appendix), but focus our primary attention on the
       sample of firms using RPE with self-selected peer groups. This final sample contains 1,623
       firm year observations with non-missing values for all required variables.

evidence.description: The construction script reads PatentsView application fields and transforms the application and patent identifiers and dates.
evidence.quote:
Applications <- fread("Data/application_data.csv.zip") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(filing_date)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(patent_issue_date) | application_type == "PCT") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(application_number)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(patent_number)) %>% 
  filter(application_type != "?") %>% 
  transmute(patent_number = patent_number %>% as.numeric,
            application_number = application_number,
            application_type = application_type %>% as.character,
            filing_date = lubridate::ymd(filing_date),
            issue_date = lubridate::ymd(patent_issue_date)) %>%

evidence.description: Foreign priority read and country-code comparisons.
evidence.quote:
Foreign <- fread("Data/foreign_priority.csv.zip") %>% 
  transmute(application_number = application_number %>% as.numeric,
            foreign_parent_date = lubridate::ymd(foreign_parent_date),
            parent_country_code = parent_country_code %>% as.character,
            US = as.numeric(parent_country_code == "US")) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  mutate(foreign_parallel_patent = 1) %>% 
  group_by(application_number) %>% 
  arrange(foreign_parent_date) %>% 
  mutate(foreign_both = as.numeric(any(parent_country_code == "US") & any(parent_country_code != "US")),
         first_foreign_parent_date = foreign_parent_date[1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(foreign_parallel_patent.US_first = as.numeric(US == 1 & first_foreign_parent_date == foreign_parent_date)) %>% 
  group_by(application_number) %>% 
  arrange(foreign_parent_date) %>% 
  summarize(foreign_parent_date = foreign_parent_date[1],
            foreign_parallel_patent = foreign_parallel_patent[1],
            foreign_parallel_patent.US_first = as.numeric(any(foreign_parallel_patent.US_first == 1))) %>% 
  ungroup(); gc()

evidence.description: Transaction file read and event/date fields consumed.
evidence.quote:
Transactions <- fread("Data/transactions.csv.zip") %>% 
  filter(event_code %in% c("EPRQ", "NPRQ")) %>% # keep only early and non-publication requests
  mutate(application_number = application_number %>% as.numeric) %>% 
  filter(application_number %in% Applications$application_number)

Transactions_EPRQ <- Transactions %>% 
  filter(event_code == "EPRQ") %>% 
  transmute(application_number,
            early_publication_request = ifelse(event_code == "EPRQ", 1, 0),
            early_publication_request_date = lubridate::ymd(recorded_date)) %>% 
  distinct()

Transactions_NPRQ <- Transactions %>% 
  filter(event_code == "NPRQ") %>% 
  transmute(application_number,
            non_publication_request = ifelse(event_code == "NPRQ", 1, 0),
            non_publication_request_date = lubridate::ymd(recorded_date)) %>% 
  distinct(); rm(Transactions)

evidence.description: Construction script produces the Combined intermediate.
evidence.quote:
Combined <- Applications %>% 
  left_join(Master,
            by = "patent_number") %>% 
  left_join(PCT,
            by = "patent_number") %>% 
  mutate(application_number = application_number %>% as.numeric) %>%
  filter(!is.na(application_number)) %>% # drop PCT and reissues
  left_join(Families,
            by = "application_number") %>% 
  left_join(Foreign,
            by = "application_number") %>% 
  left_join(Transactions_EPRQ,
            by = "application_number") %>% 
  left_join(Transactions_NPRQ,
            by = "application_number") %>%

evidence.description: Construction script produces the Assignees object and maps the type codes.
evidence.quote:
Assignees <- bind_rows(fread("Data/assignee_5m.tsv"),
                       fread("Data/assignee_6m.tsv"),
                       fread("Data/assignee_7m.tsv"),
                       fread("Data/assignee_8m.tsv"),

                       fread("Data/assignee_10m.tsv"),
                       fread("Data/assignee_11m.tsv"),
                       fread("Data/assignee_12m.tsv")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>% 
  filter(type > 1) %>% 
  transmute(patent_number = patnum %>% as.numeric,
            assignee_id = assignee_id %>% as.character,
            assignee_name = organization %>% toupper %>% as.character,
            assignee_country = country %>% toupper %>% as.character,
            assignee_state = state %>% toupper %>% as.character,
            assignee_city = city %>% toupper %>% as.character,
            assignee_type = case_when(type == 2 ~ "U.S. Company",
                                      type == 3 ~ "Foreign Company",
                                      type == 4 ~ "U.S. Individual",
                                      type == 5 ~ "Foreign Individual",
                                      type == 6 ~ "U.S. Government",
                                      type == 7 ~ "Foreign Government",
                                      type == 8 ~ "U.S. University",
                                      type == 9 ~ "Foreign University",
                                      type == 10 ~ "U.S. Nonprofit Organization",
                                      type == 11 ~ "Foreign Nonprofit Organization",
                                      type == 12 ~ "U.S. Hospital",
                                      type == 13 ~ "Foreign Hospital",
                                      type == 14 ~ "U.S. Research Institute",
                                      type == 15 ~ "Foreign Research Institute",

                                      type == 18 ~ "U.S. Cooperative",
                                      type == 19 ~ "Foreign Cooperative") %>%

evidence.description: Construction script produces and transforms Moves.all.
evidence.quote:
Moves.all <- Inventors %>% 
  select(patent_number, inventor_id) %>% 
  left_join(Combined %>% 
              select(patent_number, first_priority_date),
            by = "patent_number") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(first_priority_date)) %>% 
  left_join(Assignees %>%
              select(patent_number, assignee_id),
            by = "patent_number") %>%
  left_join(Firms %>% 
              select(patent_number, permco),
            by = "patent_number") %>% 
  transmute(inventor_id,
            permco = ifelse(!is.na(permco), permco, assignee_id),
            priority_year = lubridate::year(first_priority_date)) %>% 
  distinct()

evidence.description: Construction script produces Moves.to_control.
evidence.quote:
Moves.to_control <- Inventors %>% 
  select(patent_number, inventor_id, inventor_country, inventor_state) %>% 
  left_join(Combined %>% 
              select(patent_number, first_priority_date),
            by = "patent_number") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(first_priority_date)) %>% 
  transmute(inventor_id,
            inventor_state,
            inventor_country,
            control_state = NA,
            priority_year = lubridate::year(first_priority_date)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(inventor_country == "US") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(inventor_state)) %>% 
  filter(inventor_state != "TX") %>% 
  transmute(inventor_id, priority_year,
            control_state = ifelse(inventor_state %in% c("CA", "DE", "IL", "KS", "MN", "NC", "NV", "UT", "WA"), 1, 0),
            treat_state = ifelse(!inventor_state %in% c("CA", "DE", "IL", "KS", "MN", "NC", "NV", "UT", "WA"), 1, 0)) %>% 
  distinct()

evidence.description: Construction script creates baseline Data from Combined, Assignees, and Inventors.
evidence.quote:
Data <- Combined %>%
  filter(filing_date >= "2003-01-01" & filing_date <= "2006-12-31") %>% # [-2, +2]
  filter(continuation_patent == 0) %>% # drop continuation patents
  filter(foreign_parallel_patent == 0 | foreign_parallel_patent.US_first == 1) %>% # drop foreign patents, unless US first
  filter(first_priority_date >= filing_date) %>% # keep only earliest first date
  left_join(Assignees,
            by = "patent_number") %>%
  filter(grepl("U.S.", assignee_type) | is.na(assignee_id)) %>% # only keep U.S. assignees or individuals
  left_join(Inventors,
            by = "patent_number") %>%

evidence.description: Construction script produces Data.agglomeration.
evidence.quote:
